point_fit_policy: Frozen development-only Part 2 bundles; no holdout refit or hyperparameter/ensemble-weight tuning
calibration_policy: Sequential walk-forward: development OOF plus strictly earlier matured evaluation residuals, horizon/model conditioned, trailing 60 stride samples
selection_policy: Common-origin MAE, then Brier, then distance of coverage from 0.90; unavailable holdout horizons use development ranking explicitly
selection_consequence: This holdout is now used for selection and cannot subsequently be claimed as an untouched final test
evidence: Conditional archive targets and assumed daily close availability, not verified original-vintage real-time history
